beats: One machine polled the router and enforced every block for the whole family.
If it rebooted, lost Wi-Fi, or crashed, the blocks silently stopped.
Nobody knew — until a kid's phone was suddenly unblocked.
Now a second machine, a phone that's always home, watches too.
If the leader goes quiet, a Cloudflare Worker hands control to the other automatically.
No alert, no restart — blocking survives even when one machine goes down.
